title: Rating Manual, the Destination Loading Owed — Travel Protection Plans
content:
## 1. The charge

1.1 A Travel Protection Plans certificate carries one destination loading line for the region it declares, and where the premium lines carry none the loading is owed and is charged as its own line.

## 2. The premium the loading acts on

2.1 The premium the loading acts on is the plan's minimum premium.

## 3. The amount owed

3.1 The destination loading owed is the plan's destination loading percentage applied to that premium, taken at the share of that percentage which the length of the journey insured carries and at the share which the moment the cover was bought carries, and reduced by the protection discount that applies to the certificate.

3.2 The share the length of the journey insured carries is 40 per cent.

3.3 The share the moment the cover was bought carries is 75 per cent.

3.4 No protection discount is applied: the discount taken off the rated loading is 0 per cent of it.

3.5 The loading is rounded to two decimal places only once the discount has been taken off, and the discount acts once on the rated loading and never on any other premium line.

## 4. The quantity defined in order

The rated loading is the plan's destination loading percentage of the premium the loading acts on; that amount taken at the share the length of the journey insured carries; and that amount in turn taken at the share the moment the cover was bought carries. The protection discount is then taken off the rated loading so obtained, once and once only, and the figure that results is rounded to two decimal places. Nothing is rounded before the discount has been taken off, and no other premium line on the certificate is touched by the discount.

## 5. Worked to a figure on hypothetical inputs

Take a plan whose minimum premium is 80.00 USD and whose destination loading percentage is 20, on a certificate whose premium lines carry no destination loading.

- The premium the loading acts on is the plan's minimum premium, 80.00 USD.
- The plan's destination loading percentage of that premium is 20 per cent of 80.00 USD, which is 16.00 USD.
- Taken at the share the length of the journey insured carries, 40 per cent, that is 6.40 USD.
- Taken at the share the moment the cover was bought carries, 75 per cent, that is 4.80 USD. This is the rated loading.
- The protection discount taken off is 0 per cent of the rated loading, which leaves 4.80 USD.
- Rounded to two decimal places, the destination loading owed is 4.80 USD, and that is the amount of the line raised against the certificate.
